column3: Stedding: an open-source, Arc-style browser built on Chromium
The address row takes each page's own colour
Search, open a site, or jump to any tab in any Space
Spaces, each in its own colour, with its own cookies if you like
Drag a tab onto the page for split view, the address row in each page's colour
Fold the sidebar to icons, or hide it completely
Every website dark at once, with no white flash
Tabs on a local server are marked, with their host and port
stedding.dev · free and open source · macOS and Windows
Sand by day, a blue-to-plum gradient by night
Search, open a site, or jump to any tab in any Space
Folders in the sidebar, nested and collapsible
A pinned tab remembers its page and shows when you wander off
Private windows wear their own colours
Every website dark at once, with exceptions per site
Tabs on a local server are marked, with their host and port
A Space with its own session carries a mark
Any page can become an app of its own
